description: The wallet that launched a Robinhood Chain token and what it did since: when it launched, how much it received, how much it still holds, how much it sold into pools (how many sells, when, and roughly what that's worth now), which wallets it sent tokens to and whether those sold, and wallets linked to it by token transfers. Use for 'is the dev selling?', 'did the dev dump?', 'who launched this?'. To see where the dev's money went, follow up with wallet_flows on the deployer. Robinhood Chain only for now.
